title: ATTENUATION2 - A multicenter, randomized phase II study of the efficacy and safety of de-escalation versus standard adjuvant treatment in patients with low-risk localized gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (PRODIGE99/FRENCH 39 study)
official: ATTENUATION2 - A multicenter, randomized phase II study of the efficacy and safety of de-escalation versus standard adjuvant treatment in patients with low-risk localized gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (PRODIGE99/FRENCH 39 study).
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy (2-year DFS rate) of a de-escalation strategy (surveillance) compared to the standard post-operative treatment schedule with D-FLOT followed by durvalumab alone.
conditions: Non metastatic gastric, or gastresophageal junction adencarcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. PRE SCREEENING
2. I3. Low risk of disease recurrence, defined by the following criteria:  Absence of lymph node involvement (ypN0), assessed on a min. of 16 or 7 lymph nodes according to guidelines and,  ypT0-3
3. I4. ECOG Performance Status 0-1
4. I5. Patients fit to receive post-operative chemotherapy
5. I6. Adequate organs function (see table protocol)
6. I7. No contraindication to study assessments
7. I8. Signed and dated informed consent form,
8. I9. Patient must be covered by a medical insurance or equivalent.
9. RANDOMIZATION
10. R1. Patients fulfilling inclusion criteria
11. R2. Negative post-operative ctDNA
12. PI1.  Age ≥ 18 years
13. R3. Interval between the date of surgery and the date of randomization no longer than 10 weeks
14. PI2. Suspected non-metastatic (M0) gastric, or gastresophageal junction adenocarcinoma
15. PI3. Patient consent for WGS analysis by central laboratory, in order to design the ctDNA test (based on primary tumor  authorized and if possible most recent available tumor tissue sample)
16. PI4. Signed and dated informed consent form,
17. PI5. Patient must be covered by a medical insurance or equivalent.
18. INCLUSION CRITERIA
19. I1. Histologically proven non-metastatic (M0) gastric, or gastresophageal junction adenocarcinoma,
20. I2. Subjects must have completed both pre-operative chemotherapy with a fluoropyrimidine-platinum containing regimen associated with durvalumab (D-FLOT 4 cycles) and microscopically complete (R0) resection prior to  randomization.
Exclusion criteria:
1. NON PRE SCREENING CRITERIA
2. E3.	Contraindication to postoperative treatment (D-FLOT) according to standard practices and the SmPC (especially section 4.3 « contraindications) of the products used in this trial (durvalumab, 5-fluorouracil, oxaliplatin and docetaxel).
3. E4. Any concurrent chemotherapy, Investigational product for cancer treatment.
4. E5. Concurrent enrolment in another clinical study, unless it is an observational (non-interventional) clinical study
5. NPI3. Patient who does not have a good command of the French language or who are unable to understand the research issues. NPI2.
6. E6. Suspicion of serious infection,
7. E7. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman,
8. E8. Patient under tutorship or curatorship or deprived of liberty.
9. NIP1. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman,
10. NPI2. Patient under tutorship or curatorship of deprived of liberty.
11. NON INCLUSION CRITERIA
12. E1. Esophageal squamous cell carcinomas or esophageal adenocarcinoma,
13. E2. Persistent toxicities related to prior treatment of grade>1,
